text:
Gold Price in 2003
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2003, the LBMA gold price rose 13.3% between 2003-01-31 ($368) and 2003-12-30 ($416). The highest sampled price was $416 in December and the lowest was $335 in March. The mean of these observations was $368. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
